# Spotlight

> Spotlight is a marketing intelligence studio. Tagline: "Where marketing meets intelligence."

Spotlight turns audience data into clear strategy, sharper campaigns and measurable growth.

## Services
- Audience intelligence: who your best customers are and what they respond to
- Campaign strategy: evidence-based channel, message and budget plans
- Performance analytics: connecting spend to revenue
- Creative direction: concepts tested against real audience signals
